description: Canonical 5-step splash demo sequence — one step per product surface (idea_lab -> repo_clinic -> maintenance_bay -> learning_studio -> proof_operator_center). Required: at least one happy path (default), at least one blocked path step (Maintenance Bay missing compatibility verifier), at least one teaching step (Learning Studio beginner/pro), at least one proof view step (Proof / Operator Center). Required tagline 'Proof Before Mutation' must appear. Required phrases 'Generated is not verified.' and 'Working means build/test/smoke passed.' must appear. Required negative caveats must appear: 'not all apps', 'not all languages', 'not production-ready arbitrary apps', 'not training enabled'. build_record() refuses: (1) any step that mentions network / Docker / ProgramBench / real user mutation -> BLOCKED_FALSE_UNIVERSALITY; (2) missing tagline / phrases / caveats -> BLOCKED_FALSE_UNIVERSALITY; (3) missing blocked or teaching step or unexpected surface ordering -> BLOCKED_AUTHORITY_CONFUSION; (4) missing proof view step -> BLOCKED_MISSING_PROOF_VIEW.
